summary: One notification channel, the toast or a notification plugin, was turned on or off by notification.enable or notification.disable: whether it was on before and after, apart from the switch for every notification.

key.description: The setting the line is about, as the settings file spells its path: `Notifications:Toast`, or `Notifications:Plugins:<plugin id>:Enabled`.

old.description: Whether the channel was on in the settings in force before, or null where the settings named no such channel.

new.description: Whether the channel is on in the settings in force now. A line is written only when it differs from the one before.
